content:
maria: quick design check — pushed a tiny change to the routing policies editor sandbox. want feedback on the reorder affordance and preview validation flow.
ton y: saw it, quick reaction: the drag handle is pretty small on touch. make the hit area 24px? :point_up:
sam: agree on hit area. on desktop the cursor change isn't strong enough -> `cursor: grab` then `grabbing` during drag. also focus outline disappears while dragging, want it preserved for keyboard reorders.
elaine: copy note — the current validation toast says 'Rule not saved' when there's a priority conflict. that's too vague. suggestion: 'Conflict detected: two rules share the same priority. Click to highlight conflicts.'
maria: love that copy. also debating inline vs blocking validation: leaning inline non-blocking warnings plus disabling Save only if there are unresolved conflicts. helps with exploratory edits.
tony: preview sim behaviour: when you click "Run preview" spinner blocks the whole panel. can we progressively render matches as they stream back? users want immediate feedback.
sam: backend supports streaming chunks of results. frontend currently waits for full payload. i can change to append rows as chunks arrive — fewer perceived latency spikes.
elaine: accessibility: the priority input doesn't expose role=spinbutton; arrow keys don't work. keyboard users can't reorder without drag handles.
maria: yep. make it a spinbutton and add explicit keyboard reorder controls (move up/move down) + aria-live region for preview updates.
ux-bot: accessibility checklist updated: https://intranet.redwood/ux/a11y-checklist — please link the spinbutton guidance.
tony: tiny visual nit: row separator is 1px and disappears on dark themes. bump to 1.5px or use `rgba(255,255,255,0.06)` for contrast.
sam: implementing handle + keyboard reorder now. design question: should reordering autosave or require explicit Save?
maria: prefer explicit Save for auditability, but show an "Unsaved changes" badge and allow optimistic local preview so users can test before saving.
elaine: validation UX: in tooltip show 2–3 actionable bullets and a "Show conflicting rules" link that focuses and highlights the conflicting rows. keeps context.
sam: pinging — i'll open a PR: `feat(policy-editor): keyboard reorder + streaming preview + validation copy updates` with a small demo recording.
maria: great. can we do a 20-min playtest tomorrow 10:30am? invite two folks from Support to run their real rule sets.
tony: added to calendar, i'll bring updated mocks and a11y annotations.
elaine: i'll draft the new copy + a11y notes in the Figma file and paste examples in the PR.
ux-bot: deploy-bot: sim-service v2 deployed to sandbox at 1767778500 — streaming enabled.
maria: perfect — next steps: collect playtest notes, merge PR after a11y pass, ship a small patch release. thanks all!
